title: The addition rule in a Venn diagram
caption: Out of 100 percentage points: A alone 30, both 20, B alone 20, neither 30. P(A ∪ B) = 0.5 + 0.4 − 0.2 = 0.7, so P(neither) = 0.3: the overlap is counted once, not twice.
alt: Two overlapping circles: A only 30, both 20, B only 20, and 30 outside both, out of 100.
description: Read probabilities as percentages of one whole of 100.
The overlap A ∩ B holds 20; A has 50 in total, so A alone holds 30; B has 40, so B alone holds 20.
A ∪ B is 30 + 20 + 20 = 70, so the outside region holds 100 − 70 = 30.
